_published_faq.name: How do I add Yuno to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yuno to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-edge.agents.y.uno/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yuno MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yuno provides these MCP tools: analyze_query, read_query, and table_overview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yuno?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Yuno in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Yuno requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yuno is developed by Yuno. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
